objective: Select the next measured benchmark after closing the filelist shape-breadth timing public-pack externalization boundary.

decision.reason: The accepted filelist shape-breadth timing result is still single-run evidence across four target/shape pairs. Stabilizing the same filelist-derived 32x1 and 1x32 cases with repeat-median timing is the narrowest next step before deriving automatic GPU allocation policy from the data.

deferred_candidates.reason: Defer until filelist timing is repeat-median-backed; the current single-run result is not a strong enough basis for even a scoped allocation policy.
Defer because the project currently exposes Verilator-like entrypoints and keeps direct native Verilator option support as a non-claim.
Defer because current accepted filelist flows rely on explicit source closure and known-template materialization, not arbitrary RTL dependency inference.
Defer because it broadens back into runtime behavior, while the open weakness is the single-run filelist timing basis.

required_next_gate.name: define_filelist_shape_breadth_repeat_median_timing_gate
must_pin: the same filelist-derived targets used by the accepted single-run timing result
the 32x1 and 1x32 shapes for each selected target
repeat_count 3 unless the gate explicitly justifies a different count
CPU elapsed, hybrid wall, GPU kernel total, per-state-step timing, and speedup fields to summarize
coverage_output_equivalence as the correctness policy for each repeat sample
raw full-state equality as diagnostic only
the public command surface used for the repeat-median measurement
non-claims for native Verilator option support, arbitrary RTL support, arbitrary RTL dependency inference, automatic optimal GPU allocation, runtime/ABI changes, and production LLM-serving throughput

non_claims: not a runtime or ABI change
